description: Looks for a value in the leftmost column of a table and then returns a value in the same row from the specified column. By default, the table must be sorted in an ascending order.

params.description: The value to be found in the first column of the table. It can be a value, a reference, or a text string.
params.name: arg1

params.description: A table of text, numbers, or logical values, in which data is retrieved. It can be a range of cells.
params.name: arg2

params.description: The column number in the data table from which the matching value should be returned. The first column of values in the table is column 1.
params.name: arg3

params.description: A logical value that specifies whether to find the closest match in the first column (sorted in ascending order) (**true** or omitted)or find an exact match (**false**).
params.name: arg4

signature: VLOOKUP(arg1: number | string | ApiRange | ApiName, arg2: ApiRange | ApiName, arg3: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg4?: ApiRange | ApiName | boolean): number | string
